thread:
Jordan: Thanks for joining the all-hands recap. Quick thread to collect follow-up Qs on hiring & org shifts — I'll answer what I can.
Marta: Two notes from People: hiring freeze is lifted for Q3 roles; we still need to prioritize. Focus areas: infra, reliability, dev tools.
Aisha: Does that mean headcount for eng-platform is confirmed? @Marta
Marta: Yes — funding approved for 6 hires in eng-platform across Q3 (ICs + 1 manager). We'll post reqs next week.
Marco: What about internal mobility for ML infra folks who want to move into serving runtime?
Sam: We support internal moves. TL;DR: 3-month ramp + paired onboarding. Talk to your manager and @Remy to start the transfer.
Remy: FYI relocation budget is limited; we prefer remote-first or local candidates unless role requires office presence.
Tara: Any PM roles tied to the reorg? Should product squads expect changes?
Jordan: We're consolidating Product Search + Discovery into a Product Platform team to improve discovery velocity. No layoffs — mostly reassignments and one new TPM role.
Aisha: Which squads will be directly affected?
Jordan: Leads of Search and Discovery will host a sync next Monday with a proposed org map.
Priya: Will on-call be impacted for teams involved?
Sam: On-call will be redistributed for the transition; expect one extra week of rotation spread over the next two sprints. We'll update the rotation doc soon.
Devon: For Dedicated customers, are we increasing Customer Success headcount?
Marta: Yes — planning to add +2 CSMs focused on Dedicated accounts in Q4.
Aisha: Can People publish a hiring roadmap so teams can plan interviews and mentoring slots?
Marta: Will publish a concise hiring roadmap by Friday: role list, priority tier (1-3), and tentative timelines.
Jordan: Actionable ask — if your team needs priority hires, submit a short role brief. Leads will get prioritization signals from product and infra owners.
Remy: Action items captured: 1) Hiring roadmap by Friday; 2) Leads to submit role briefs by Thursday; 3) Internal mobility playbook link will be posted.
Aisha: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone.
Sam: thanks.
Jordan: If anything sensitive, DM me or @Marta. We'll post an FAQ in #all-hands-resources after the sync.
